title: Add startup reconciliation dry-run evidence
summary: Adds a backend-owned startup reconciliation dry-run that reports pending-publish, ActiveJobs, and SQLite mirror ambiguity without repairing or mutating state.
reason: The autonomy pilot needs restart/crash ambiguity to be visible before a long unattended run. This slice adds proven-only dry-run evidence and keeps all repair, drain, publish, cleanup, and source movement out of scope.
behavior_before: Repair/reconcile dry-runs existed for selected completed and pending-publish review cases, but there was no aggregate startup reconciliation dry-run covering pending manifests, orphaned parked outputs, ActiveJobs, and SQLite mirror posture.
behavior_after: POST /api/startup/reconcile-dry-run and the facade startup dry-run report machine-readable restart ambiguity from backend state only, suppress command journaling, expose no mutation route, and never write, move, delete, drain, publish, repair, migrate, rebuild, or clean up media/state files.
manual_validation: Initial focused unittest for tests.python.desktop.test_repair_reconcile_dry_run failed as expected before implementation: missing plan_startup_reconciliation_dry_run and 404 for /api/startup/reconcile-dry-run.
Python no-bytecode import check for touched modules - passed
git diff --check for touched files - passed (line-ending warnings only)
rollback_plan: Remove the startup reconciliation dry-run route, command payload contract, facade adapter, dry-run helper, contract/inventory entries, tests, generated summaries, and this change packet. Rollback is evidence-only and does not touch media, manifests, ActiveJobs, pending payloads, or SQLite mirror files.
notes: This is a proven-only dry-run slice. The startup dry-run opens SQLite with mode=ro and does not call ActiveJobs cleanup/reconcile helpers. No startup repair mutation, pending-publish drain, ActiveJobs cleanup, SQLite migration/rebuild, source movement, cleanup, FFmpeg, subtitle, or audio behavior is intentionally changed.
